# MeedyaDL 1.9.3

A small readability fix for the Activity log.

### What's fixed

- **Large batches of queued links no longer show up as one giant wall of text in the Activity log.** When you queue lots of URLs at once — for example, an artist link expanded into many albums, or a big playlist — the "Queued: …" entry now lists each link on its own line instead of jamming them all together, matching the readable format already used for skipped-duplicate and nothing-queued messages.
